context: rollout Phase D3 on a post-migrate project with a Spanish twin subtree (hands-off). Task and setup in task.md; each item is judged pass/fail and weighted by max_score.

checklist.name: manifest_before_fanout
checklist.description: stardust/trees.json is written before any twin page or per-language document is staged, in the multilingual.md § Manifest precondition shape: default, decisions.locale, one entry per tree with lang, root, twinRoot, source, nav/footer/search/contact, chromeSource, and a strings table. Every strings entry is either lifted (lifted: true, value verbatim from stardust/current/trees/es/chrome.json) or owner: true; form-confirmation is owner: true with a null value. A translated string, a missing manifest, or D3 work started before it fails.

checklist.name: lang_and_alternate_rows
checklist.description: Every staged page carries a `lang` metadata row (es on the twins); /es/ and /es/negocios/ carry alternate-en and alternate-es rows whose values are the captured hreflang hrefs. Missing rows, invented URLs or a lang row only on some pages fails.

checklist.name: locale_chrome_from_probe
checklist.description: /es/nav and /es/footer are authored from trees/es/chrome.json — primary labels and hover children verbatim, the switcher pointing at each language's home, the footer legal line as captured — and the twins resolve them via nav/footer metadata rows or the documented path-prefix fallback in the header/footer block. English chrome reused for Spanish pages, or agent-translated labels, fails.

checklist.name: two_line_runtime_hook
checklist.description: The only change proposed or staged for scripts/scripts.js is the documented hook: document.documentElement.lang read from the lang metadata row in loadEager, plus an alternate-* link builder inside buildAutoBlocks(). Restructuring loadEager/decorateMain, adding reveal or scroll code, or hard-coding a language fails.

checklist.name: twin_gate_360_first
checklist.description: The gate plan or attempt for the /es/ twin of the passed landing archetype runs 360 before 1440 at the unchanged bars (the archetype rule '1440 first' is not applied to twins). The .example origin is unreachable: the result is reported as no verdict (not a pass, not a FAIL), and nothing is published under hands-off.

checklist.name: brand_surface_untouched
checklist.description: stardust/current/_brand-extraction.json is byte-identical to the fixture at the end of the run and no root PRODUCT.md / DESIGN.md / DESIGN.json is regenerated; Spanish evidence stays under stardust/current/trees/es/. Any re-aggregation of the default-language surface fails.

checklist.name: no_literal_tree_paths
checklist.description: No staged block JS/CSS or scripts.js contains a literal /es/ or /en/ path; locale roots appear only in content documents, metadata rows, per-language helix-query.yaml index entries and helix-sitemap.yaml `languages` entries (source /<lang>/query-index.json, destination /<lang>/sitemap.xml, hreflang, alternate).

checklist.name: hands_off_owner_items_by_name
checklist.description: Hands-off asks nothing: the OWNER string (form-confirmation) and the locale-scope decision are recorded by name in the report and status.jsonl (interim tier, run continues) rather than resolved by invention or by stopping the run.
